name: Ivy
rootCause: Project Ivy on BSC Suspected of Exit Scam. Contract Address: 0xf99f2Aec50adFde23cc67aB6240168B0a59f1D30 which dropped >94%. EOA 0x5c30 removed $1.58m liquidity which caused the drop.

descriptions.text: Project Ivy on BSC Suspected of Exit Scam. Contract Address: 0xf99f2Aec50adFde23cc67aB6240168B0a59f1D30 which dropped >94%. EOA 0x5c30 removed $1.58m liquidity which caused the drop.

Public October 2023 security recaps identified IVY as a rug pull on BNB Chain. Available reporting states that the token deployer removed liquidity and exited with roughly $1.58 million, but primary transaction records, contract addresses, and a complete onchain reconstruction were not publicly identified during review. The available evidence describes a liquidity rug pull in which the IVY token deployer retained effective control over the trading liquidity and withdrew it from the market. Public sources do not provide the token contract, liquidity pool address, or verified transaction history needed to independently reconstruct the exact execution path.
